reason: We do library storytime, the park and church group, and those are free. I don't pay for kid activities, and $59 a month is a lot when the free options already fill the week.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Up to age 5 in the same room as an 8-month-old worries me, and I'd be paying to find out.
would_change_my_mind: A separate, gated baby area or a posted baby-only hour, plus a free trial visit to see how the room actually feels.
